coverage.proposal_item: F-01: first-class skill accepts WI list and produces a wave plan
F-02: transport choice documented for Agent/subagent/headless execution
coverage.note: Implemented with current transport names: local-inline, subagent, detached-kimi, headless-worker.

coverage.proposal_item: F-0x: task-graph boilerplate must be subagent-aware
coverage.note: Worker file-state rule and SVC_SUBAGENT are present; per-worker Stop-hook filtering remains a child WI.

coverage.proposal_item: F-03: WI files declare affected files structurally and authoring skills fill them
coverage.note: Canonical WI metadata, authoring-skill guidance, and high/critical metadata validation are implemented.

coverage.proposal_item: F-04: merge-back contract after parallel wave completes
coverage.note: Merge-back result validation is implemented; worker-side result production is tracked under WI-328.
Planner output now records worker_model and rationale from WI metadata.

coverage.proposal_item: F-07: conflict detection covers shared config and import graph reachability
coverage.note: Planner now adds reverse import scan dependencies and records dependency confidence/degraded warnings.

coverage.proposal_item: F-08: hooks adapt for multi-session wave execution
coverage.note: SVC_WORKER_WI filters Stop-hook scope, dispatch-worker emits result/progress/edit artifacts, and stop-quality rolls worker edits into parent checks.
Reference locks one PR per WI unless the user explicitly asks for consolidation.

coverage.proposal_item: F-10: shared-resource arbitration and concurrency cap
coverage.note: Concurrency cap, inline threshold, Base44 TEST_STREAM assignment, browser slots, and serialization are implemented.
dispatch-worker emits timeout, non-zero, dirty-tree, result, log, and progress artifacts; merge-back validation catches missing/invalid results.
Proposal itself marks this as host-harness limitation and track-only, not actionable framework work.
